name: veterinary_clinic_system_044_provider_utilization_report
instruction: Build the provider utilization report as of the episode date. Identify every provider whose role is 'veterinarian'. For each of those providers, push exactly one ops_reports row {report: 'provider_utilization', batch_code, provider_id, provider_name, role, total_appointments, completed, no_shows, upcoming, completed_rate, no_show_rate}. Definitions: total_appointments = every appointment assigned to that provider regardless of date or status; completed = count with status 'completed'; no_shows = count with status 'no_show'; upcoming = count with appointment_date on or after the episode date and status in ('scheduled','confirmed','checked_in'); completed_rate = round(100*completed/total_appointments, 1), or 0.0 if total is 0; no_show_rate = round(100*no_shows/total_appointments, 1), or 0.0 if total is 0. Providers whose role is not 'veterinarian' are decoys and must not be in the report. No other collections may be modified.
_steps_note: par_steps and max_steps cannot be measured in a codegen-only session. They must be recorded from a live gold run in the QC container.

success_criteria.summary: ops_reports contains exactly one row per veterinarian provider (4 rows total) with report='provider_utilization' and batch_code. Each row's counts must match the live appointments table: total, completed, no_shows, and upcoming (date >= episode and status in scheduled/confirmed/checked_in). Rates must be rounded to one decimal and 0.0 when total is 0. Non-veterinarian providers are absent. Every aggregate is recomputed via Python filter and an independent SQL GROUP BY and both must agree with the agent's written row. All collections outside ops_reports are canary-checked.

checks.expect: 4 provider_utilization rows with exact counts and rates
per-provider total/completed/no_show/upcoming counts agree between Python filter and SQL GROUP BY

hazards: Only providers with role='veterinarian' may appear. The seed has 4 veterinarians (ids 1-4: Dr. Elena Alvarez, Dr. Marcus Chen, Dr. Priya Natarajan, Dr. Sam Okafor) and 5 non-vet staff (ids 5-9: vet_techs, kennel_attendants, groomer). A report that includes all 9 providers fails.

upcoming is a compound condition: appointment_date >= episode (inclusive) AND status in ('scheduled','confirmed','checked_in'). A solution that counts all future appointments regardless of status, or all scheduled/confirmed without the date filter, will inflate the count.
The episode date jitters +/-3 days, so the 'upcoming' boundary is live. Hardcoding a fixed episode date produces wrong upcoming counts.
completed_rate and no_show_rate must be rounded to one decimal; an unrounded or integer rate fails the tolerance check. For providers with total=0, both rates must be 0.0.
provider_name and role must be read from the providers collection; a hardcoded name or role fails.
total_appointments includes every appointment assigned to the provider, including those in the past and those with status 'no_show' or 'completed'. Excluding any status undercounts.
No collections outside ops_reports may be modified. The appointments and providers tables are canary-checked byte-identical.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Hardmode v2 expands from a single-report v1 into a per-veterinarian utilization report with no_show_rate and completed_rate percentages rounded to one decimal, and requires dual-path derivation of every per-provider count. The 'upcoming' metric is a date + status compound condition. Non-veterinarian providers are decoys that must be excluded. The report is read-only with respect to appointments and providers; only ops_reports is written.
